newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nichiboshin says creditors accept restructure plan.
newsitem.headline: Nichiboshin says creditors accept restructure plan.

text.p: Non-bank financial institution Nichiboshin Ltd said on Monday that all of its creditors had agreed to accept its restructuring plan.
"All of our creditors have understood our restructuring programme and they have 100 percent agreed to the plan," the company said in a statement.
Nichiboshin, a non-bank, said it would continue its utmost efforts to implement the programme by continuing to collect problem loans and to cut costs.
Under the restructuring plan, covering five years and formed in September 1995, Nichiboshin called for its more than 100 creditors to forgive some of their loans.
Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said last week that Nichiboshin's plan called for the creditors to forgive a total of 500 billion yen in loans at the rate of 100 billion yen per year.
